title: ほうほうほたるこい (Hotaru Koi — Come Here, Firefly)
description: A traditional Edo-period children's warabe-uta (folk chant) calling fireflies to come near. Children would sing this at dusk while chasing fireflies in summer fields, coaxing them with the promise that the water on this side is sweet while the water over there is bitter.
license: Public Domain (Traditional Japanese warabe-uta, Edo period)
